g.text: Rafters land opposite each other on the ridge board (IRC R802.3).
Hips: 2 in nominal min, no shallower than the rafter they carry (IRC R802.4.3).
Below 3:12 the ridge and hips must be designed as beams (IRC R802.4.4).
2x8 at 16 in o.c. spans about 17 ft; 2x6 about 13 ft, 2x10 about 22 ft.
Spans, sizes and the building are fictional.
